protocol.purpose: Post hoc mechanism experiment on the priced pool from market study 04. Separate retained training memory, ongoing plasticity, and immediate reinforcement stimulation behind the extra BUY. This is not a new out-of-sample trading score.
protocol.training: Reproduce the original online training observations and reinforcement from the recorded ledger; verify input and spike-count hashes before testing.
protocol.probe: Reset neural activity and sensory/rate traces before each arm. Retain or restore training memory as declared. Replay the exact three recorded test images; recorded pulse mode uses none, aversive, reward independently of counterfactual outputs.
checks: Pristine frozen without pulses must reproduce the original frozen test spike counts.
Trained online with recorded pulses must reproduce the original online test spike counts.
All arms receive identical test images.
Frozen arms must preserve all weight and efficacy memory.
Keep the full graph, native integrator and fixed decoder unchanged.
protocol.interpretation: Actions are diagnostics only. No simulated account is recomputed, no variant selected for profit, and no policy is automatically promoted. Publish all eight arms even if no mechanism is isolated.
